title: Do the brackets match?
prompt:
Text can contain three kinds of brackets: round `( )`, square `[ ]` and curly `{ }`. The brackets are *matched* when every opening bracket is closed by a bracket of the **same kind**, and brackets close in the opposite order they opened: `{[()]}` is matched, but `([)]` and `(]` are not.

Write `isBalanced(text)` that takes a string of 0 to 40 characters and returns `true` if its brackets are matched and `false` if not. Characters that are not brackets are ignored. A string with no brackets is matched.

Examples:

- `isBalanced("{[()]} ok")` returns `true`
- `isBalanced("([)]")` returns `false`
hints: When you meet a closing bracket, which opening bracket must be the most recent one that is still open?
Which simple structure lets you add an opening bracket and later take back the latest one, in last-in, first-out order?
Besides a wrong kind of closing bracket, what two other situations make the text not matched?
